Episode 257. The Demon Army' Attack (9)
There was no end.
Since they did not know the exact scale of the enemies, as time went on, the Vamel Alliance's side was bound to become mentally exhausted more quickly.
No matter how much they killed and cut, after about ten minutes, a new white fleet would appear and fill the empty space.
Furthermore, the barrier of the Golden Fleet was slowly crumbling, and with each instance, the rate at which casualties occurred also increased.
However, the members of the coalition did not lose their morale.

It was thanks to the sight of the Genesis Knights and superhumans fighting fiercely on the front lines on the ground, not inside the golden ships. Among them, it was especially the Genesis Knights who were boosting the coalition members' morale.

The Demon Army had already sent dozens of Genesis Knights to the battlefield. However, among them, there was not a single person who had as much of a meaningful impact as the coalition's Genesis Knights.

Either they were turned to ash by the Plutonian Cannon from the very start, or even if they barely survived, they would fall to the combined attack of the coalition's Genesis Knights, or they would die, unable to overcome the Realm of Emptiness.
Even now that the Plutonian Cannon and Realm of Emptiness were all gone, that composition had not changed much.

It was because the four of them—Chiron, Vahn, Jin, and Luna—were searching for the enemy Genesis Knights as if they were hunting for lice and defeating them one by one. So to speak, the Genesis Knights of the Demon Army were unable to "establish a position."
“Chiron, it's that ship!”
It was Vahn.

Unlike Chiron, she had not yet unfolded the final ultimate technique of the Battle God, the Plutonian Domination Sword. If she were to unfold it, she could sweep away the enemies in a single breath like Realm of Emptiness and completely take the initiative of the battlefield for at least two hours.

However, she could not fight in a complete state like Chiron after unfolding the final chapter of the Plutonian Domination Sword. That was why she needed to save it as much as possible for the variables that might come in the future. Because there were still four days of war left, and furthermore, she didn't know if Jin would be able to return immediately after entering the arrangement after four days.
Instead, Vahn was using her superior senses and insight, even among the four, to instantly pinpoint the location of the Demon Army' Genesis Knights whenever they appeared on the battlefield.
“Understood!”

Before Chiron could answer, Vahn's single sword flash was already striking the corresponding ship like a thunderbolt. Following that, as Chiron swung Barisada at that location, the ship was immediately split into a cross and decomposed.

Except for the sharp, deafening roar of the lightning unique to the Sword of the King of the Dead, the sound of the ship exploding could not even be heard. It just decomposed like scattering grains of sand under Chiron's ensuing sword strike.

Of the crew of about fifty, only three survived. Two 10-star mages and one Genesis Knight. The coalition's superhumans who were nearby rushed towards the mages, and Jin and Luna attached themselves to the Genesis Knight.
“Keuk!”

Five seconds. No, three seconds. From the perspective of the Demon Army' Genesis Knight, if he could just hold out for three seconds, he could seek a path to survival. Because the support bombardment and magic of the White Fleet were covering the members of the coalition, and the other Genesis Knights who had emerged at a slightly further location could surely intervene in that amount of time.
“Die!”
But there was no way the path to survival visible to his eyes would not be visible to the coalition's Genesis Knights. That was why Jin and Luna stuck to him even more like demons.

They were not afraid of getting hurt. Even when the ray of light from the counterattacking Genesis Knight mage grazed their eyes, they increased their speed even more explosively and thrust their swords even more boldly.
A Genesis Knight.
Those who had reached that realm were bound to imagine fighting those who had reached the same position as them.

A battle between two people trained to the extreme was highly likely to be a clash of walls, lasting for a very long time without a single opening. Unless one was clearly superior to the opposing Genesis Knight, like Chiron or Vahn.

However, a battlefield with multiple Genesis Knights was a domain that was difficult for even them to imagine. In the entire history of all dimensions, there had never been a time when so many Genesis Knights had been gathered in a single world.

If it was a situation that all those who had reached a similar realm were experiencing for the first time, naturally, the side that adapted faster would have the advantage. A Genesis Knight was not exempt from that truth.

In that sense, the coalition's Genesis Knights were accumulating experience much more effectively than the enemy. They were choosing a path of all-out attack that relied on wild instincts like a beast, breaking away from the frame of a 'perfect and solid fight.'
So to speak, the coalition's Genesis Knights were throwing a gamble at every moment. A gamble where four, or two, people could kill an enemy Genesis Knight in a single breath.
Kwadeudeudeuk!

The axe-sword Krantel struck the Genesis Knight mage's staff. The moment the blade dug halfway into the body of the staff, the mage pretended to counterattack Luna and fired a ray of light at Jin, who had rushed in from the rear.

That one move in that moment, neither Jin nor Luna could perfectly read. Therefore, originally, the right choice would have been to retreat for now and see the next move, but the siblings extended their swords to the end.
The ray of light bounced off Bradamante and then deeply grazed Jin's cheek, and Luna pulled on Krantel and struck the mage's face with her fist.
Jjeong-!

The mage, even in the midst of that, put up a shield and absorbed the shock, but his face was crushed like dough and became a grotesque shape. A clear critical hit; in the ensuing consecutive strikes and Jin's thrust, he died as he was.
It was before the three seconds he had been trying to hold out for had passed.

At a glance, it looked as if they had taken down one Genesis Knight without any particular damage, but it was a composition where it would not have been strange for either Luna or Jin to have fallen into a state of serious injury.
That kind of composition had already been carried out over a dozen times. Jin and Luna were barely avoiding serious injury, and that could be said to be the result of extreme luck.

However, now, experience had been accumulated in addition to luck. While the coalition's Genesis Knights were getting a feel for it, the Demon Army' Genesis Knights were still unable to find their bearings.
'If three, no. If even two of them establish a position, it will be impossible to kill the enemy commanders in this way.'
If two or more of the Demon Army' Genesis Knights were to establish a position like that at the same time, even once, the front line would immediately begin to be pushed back.
The bombardment of the White Fleet poured down behind Jin and Luna, and the fire-element magic of another Genesis Knight mage, who was a step too late, exploded.

Shadow Sword and Crimson Sword; if the siblings emitted their sword-aura and withstood the attack for a moment, Chiron and Vahn, who had been approaching until just now, would break through the bombardment and the fire and charge at the enemy Genesis Knight again.

After that, their roles would switch for a moment. It was the same that Vahn would find the location of the enemy Genesis Knight, but it was Jin and Luna's role to create an opening for Chiron to penetrate that way.
But in the meantime, behind them, their allies were dying without rest. Golden ships were exploding, knights were being massacred, and superhumans were falling into a state of serious injury.
The worst war in the history of the Vamel Alliance.

The Sword Emperor's Holy Land War, the Evil God War, the Great Demon Realm War, the Red Plutonian War, and even the final battle against this world's Zipple. In those numerous battles, there had never been a time when so many casualties had occurred in the coalition.
“Kraaak...!”

This time, the swords of Chiron and Vahn pierced the neck and chest of an enemy Genesis Knight. Unlike Jin and Luna before, they did not sustain any particular injuries even while carrying out a reckless attack.
If the flow continued like this, the coalition would be able to penetrate even deeper into the enemy lines and hunt the next Genesis Knight.
But the tide of the war was always ready to mock the coalition. They could not maintain their advantage forever with just the two overwhelming Genesis Knights, Chiron and Vahn, at the forefront.
“Youngest!”
It was Chiron's voice. A ray of light from a Genesis Knight mage, who had just emerged from a dimensional gate and had not yet been detected by Vahn, was falling on Jin's head.

A light-element magic; there was a world that had restored the lost magic of Chenmei. Jin barely managed to raise his sword like a shield and block the ray, but he could not completely absorb the shock.
“Keoheok!”
Jin, who had been thrown back about a hundred steps while spitting out a mouthful of fresh blood, immediately grasped the extent of his internal injuries and raised his body.

A follow-up attack did not follow. It was thanks to Chiron, Luna, and Vahn already moving in to pressure the mage who had shot Jin. Jin surveyed his surroundings while washing away the feeling of a backlash that felt like it would come for a few seconds.

It was the middle of the superhumans' hand-to-hand combat. Knights and mages who were at least 9-star, and the Elonas of the Holy Army were engaged in battle, causing earthquakes all over the battlefield.
At their center were Hedo and the former Black Knights, including Vanessa. If they had not held down the Elonas, the superhumans' fight would have long ago tilted in favor of the Demon Army.
Soon, Jin, who had collected his energy, was about to leap to join Luna's side, but at that moment, he saw the back of one person.

The Ghost Leader, Lata Proch, one of his most faithful subordinates and companions. He had already lost his right arm and was facing the flocking superhumans of the Demon Army. If he were left as he was, there was no chance of survival.
Because of that, Jin reflexively tried to spray his sword-aura towards Lata's side, but he gritted his teeth and turned his direction.
If he were to use a few seconds to look after him, the price could return as the entire coalition suffering for several hours.
“...You have thought well, my lord. Go quickly!”

Even the fleet of the Ghost Squad, which was being commanded by his younger sister, Fey Proch, was not supporting him. And Fey also had the same thought as Lata. That it was right for Jin to just pass him by.
“Lata, survive!”
Lata did not answer and smiled to himself as he watched Jin's retreating back.
And the moment Jin finished re-entering the Genesis Knights' battlefield, the Ghost Leader, Lata Proch, became a person who could never answer again.

Due to Lata's death, the balance of the battlefield he had been on collapsed. The superhumans of the Demon Army passed through the path he had been blocking and began to charge directly at the Golden Fleet, and Jin, perceiving that flow, could only blink his eyes once. For now, that was the only time he had to mourn Lata.
“Huuk, hu...!”
Luna panted for breath and looked back at Jin. She was speaking with her expression. The story that, in the end, two of the Demon Army' Genesis Knights had managed to establish a position at once.
“...Youngest, you have to choose. Either bring more superhuman-level forces here even if it means taking damage to the fleet, or we fight while taking on more risks ourselves.”

It was right to choose the former. Jin had no choice but to immediately make a heavy decision. Right now, the state of the Genesis Knights was more important than any other force, excluding Lafrarosa.
With a devastating heart, he was about to call for more superhumans, but at that moment, Jin turned sharply his body around and looked behind him.
Hwaaaaaa...!
Above the flying fortress Lafrarosa, a giant golden dimensional gate was opening. Focal and Silkia, they had returned, leading the reinforcements.
